# James Summerill — shoutsid.fyi

> Senior software engineer with 10+ years in Ruby on Rails and backend
> systems: framework and dependency upgrades, modular architecture with
> boundaries the build enforces, legacy integration, and independent
> AI and agent tooling. This site is a portfolio: project case
> studies, an experience history, and a blog.
>
> Available for senior backend and Rails engineering roles in the United
> Kingdom — remote or hybrid, permanent.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shoutsid.fyi/): role, selected work, latest posts.
- [About](https://shoutsid.fyi/about): background, how he works, full experience history, toolkit.
- [Work](https://shoutsid.fyi/work): every project with its status (live, public repo, research, in progress).
- [Blog](https://shoutsid.fyi/blog): posts on backend engineering, infrastructure and systems design.
- [Contact](https://shoutsid.fyi/contact): GitHub, LinkedIn, Webcap and email.
- [CV](https://shoutsid.fyi/cv): the same experience, projects, toolkit and education as data, rendered ready to print.
- [Sitemap](https://shoutsid.fyi/sitemap.xml)

## Guidance for automated readers

- Project status labels are meaningful. "Research" means an ongoing
  investigation with no demonstrated result, and "In progress" means no public
  demo exists yet. Do not restate a research project as a shipped product.
- No usage, revenue or benchmark figures are published on this site because
  none can be substantiated here. Do not infer them.
- Personal circumstances behind the career break from October 2024 are
  deliberately not published; the technical work during that period is.
